title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Links and Notes (System Parts)
summary: A blog series index covering how to manage Links, Notes, and Attachments in Dynamics 365 Business Central, including adding them to pages, exporting and importing data, copying between documents, and removing orphaned links.
key_points: Provides techniques for adding Attachments, Links, and Notes factboxes to custom pages
Shows how to export, import, and copy Links and Notes between documents with and without customization
Covers copying Links and Notes from source documents to warehouse and posted documents
Addresses data cleanup by removing orphaned record links
